subject.title: iOS/WebChat messages append to transcript but do not trigger/deliver assistant replies

question: Is the current merged iOS reconnect and reply-session conflict work sufficient to close #97983, or should maintainers require a fresh native iOS/WebChat live repro on current main or beta first?
rationale: The code now contains adjacent fixes, but the issue's central evidence is a native iOS app-originated no-reply path that has not been proven fixed on current main.

options.title: Require fresh native iOS proof
options.body: Run a real current-main or beta native iOS/WebChat send against the Gateway and only close once the transcript, logs, and visible reply show the app-originated turn starts and delivers correctly.

options.title: Close with existing adjacent fixes
options.body: Close only if maintainers accept #100277 and #98835 as sufficient proof despite the lack of issue-linked native iOS reproduction evidence.

options.title: Split remaining roots
options.body: Move client-id collision or restart-recovery route ownership into narrower canonical issues before closing this umbrella report.

recommendation.title: Require fresh native iOS proof
recommendation.body: Run a real current-main or beta native iOS/WebChat send against the Gateway and only close once the transcript, logs, and visible reply show the app-originated turn starts and delivers correctly.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the current assignee on the live issue and is best positioned to decide the native app proof bar.
